<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Sanitizing Pin](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2697)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Rusthenge</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Talisman" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=155" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rusthenge](/Sources.aspx?ID=215) pg. 59

**Price** 7 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to armor

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Free Action" /><row>command</row></row>

 

**Trigger** You attempt a saving throw against a [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) or [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126).

 
</row>

</column>

---

This pin includes a piece of gauze wrapped around a dried herbal poultice. When you activate the _sanitizing pin_, the poultice dissolves and bolsters your body's defense against poison or disease. You gain a +2 status bonus on your Fortitude save against the initial exposure to the affliction. If you roll a critical failure on the triggering attempt, you get a failure instead.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Sanitizing Pin
